limitations: This is a source semantic review, not release acceptance or proof of live behavior.
Native Windows/Linux/macOS Intel execution, trusted remote install/update channel and public signing/notarization remain unverified. Cross-compilation does not establish native execution.
Local prefix binary and ownership checksum publication is fail-closed after interruption but is not a two-file atomic transaction. No adversarial directory replacement guarantee is asserted.
Project skill lifecycle uses validated host-local CLI-managed state, cooperative locks and atomic replacement. Its checksum detects local edits; it is not an authenticity signature.
Guide startup identity lookup was independently reviewed under command_recovery; later startup fixes are outside these two unchanged skill implementation blobs.
Later CI/Makefile/test portability changes are outside this historical checkpoint and require separate follow-up coverage.

owner_execution_reports.scope: Owner reports shared-working-tree matrix and native macOS arm64/Node compatibility, explicitly not an immutable release candidate.
